en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large cobblestoned market square surrounded by multi‑story historic buildings. Small groups of people and carts stand in the open square, and there is a central trellised structure or pavilion with trees. On the right side rises a church or town‑hall tower with a spire topped by a cross. The lower margin of the card bears printed red text identifying the place and publisher.
